name: Speed pass
description: Performance hygiene without third-party claims: media sizes complete, unused media listed, transient garbage collected, cron queue sane, core/plugins up to date, Site Health clean.

steps.title: Baseline
steps.detail: Call wp_get_site_info and wp_run_site_health; note any performance-related failing tests as the baseline.

steps.title: Media sizes
steps.detail: Call wp_list_missing_sizes (per_page=20). If images miss generated sizes, call wp_regenerate_thumbnails for the listed ids.

steps.title: Unused media
steps.detail: Call wp_find_unused_media (per_page=50) and report the list: deletion is a separate owner decision, this playbook never deletes.

steps.title: Transients
steps.detail: Call wp_get_transients and delete obviously expired junk with wp_delete_transient (never object-cache internals, never options).

steps.title: Cron queue
steps.detail: Call wp_list_cron_events and report overdue events; run a single stuck one with wp_run_cron_event if the owner confirms.

steps.title: Updates
steps.detail: Call wp_list_plugins and wp_list_themes; if updates are pending, call wp_update_plugins only after owner confirmation (checkpoint exists via Site Health history).

steps.title: Report
steps.detail: Summarize: baseline issues, media fixed, transients cleaned, cron state, updates applied, and the two highest-impact next steps for the owner.

guardrails: wp_update_plugins runs only with explicit owner confirmation and never on production without a backup statement.
Never deactivate any plugin during a speed pass: conflicts are a separate investigation.
